The Animal Pose Auditor flagged a HIGH risk due to low confidence in limb/ear keypoints. There is no visual evidence of melting, fusion, or structural collapse in the visible regions. The Router's decision to mark zero artifacts is correct, as the pose auditor's warnings are false positives caused by the image crop, not AI generation errors.
